svg.title: SFP learns which format helps you
svg.desc: How often the first pick is in the format this person likes, on topics new to them. Simulated people, with a history of skills they liked. 40 new tasks in all. When a task names a format ("as text"), SFP followed it on 75% of these tasks.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
